row.body: A bank key and market receipt are clipped to a westbound travel slip; the departure is signed, but the receiving station is blank.
row.title: The westbound schedule

sidecar.gloss: A westbound transfer is signed out without a receiving station.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field team could have moved supplies between sites; the blank station does not establish a failed response.

row.body: the sponge and folded road map are tied with cut warning tape. six tally cuts mark the sponge; only four are crossed through.
row.title: missing count beside the sponge

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
